_comment: The TUI's pickers read the kconfig-only Registry, so a Roadrunner, CMake or PlatformIO type the CLI tracks did not exist in the menu. The type list is what every picker reads; menuconfig still offers kconfig types only; add-serial reaches the CLI handler for a non-kconfig type. Build asks for a firmware target only for types whose handler reads -f.

mutations.name: the type picker reads every declared type, not the kconfig registry's
mutations.replace: return [e for e in typelist.load(cli.ctx().paths) if e.builder == "kconfig_make"]

mutations.name: add-serial reaches the CLI handler for a non-kconfig type
only a kconfig type's detected boards are narrowed to its chipset
mutations.find: chipset = (entry.chipset or None) if filters_by_chipset(entry) else None

mutations.name: build asks for a firmware target only where the handler reads one
